examples.ja: 彼は結構しぶといね。転んでもただでは起きぬ、いい根性しているよ。
examples.en: He's a tenacious guy who always manages to come out on top. He's the kind of guy who can turn any situation to his advantage.

examples.ja: 乳酸菌はかなりしぶとい菌で、冷凍しても単に冬眠するだけで、解凍すればそのまま復活させることができます。
examples.en: Lactic-acid bacilli are such unyielding bacteria that, even if frozen, they would simply hibernate and can restore themselves as if they came back to life.
